result.summary: Spec written at base 6869a3e6: 83,166 bytes, pure ASCII, LF, gitignored; the worktree's git status stays empty. The AR strings appear as JSON \u escapes, generated by a script so the file stays ASCII. It is a client FOCUS unit with no flag; its main invariant is that absent keys or metadata give today's rendering and today's requests. The parts: (A) remove the fabricated surfaces: CohortBadge (deleted, zero renderers left), the InviteeQuiz 78 fallback, the LoadingRings 2074 default, the Home / Profile / History savings surfaces (hidden, because /home/savings sums estimated and converted prices), the '30 seconds' clause, and ORPHAN-7, the seven unread keys that state uncomputed numbers. That subset is drawn from 209 measured unreferenced keys using a stated rule. (B) the category row becomes one Fragrances chip plus 'Fragrances only for now'; the Skincare / Makeup coming-soon chips appear only when SF1 `surfaces` is sent with the boolean true. The cache is a new pure store, launchSurfaces.ts, fed from the existing /app/version read inside checkForcedUpdate (no new request; Expo Go stays absent). `selected_category=fragrances` is sent only when the user picked the chip AND categories_live contains it. QUICK_CATS becomes the single fragrance tile, and the examples and hero become fragrance copy. (C) D20: field_status and section_status render the honest line, and a price shows its store and as-of date under the owner's staleness rule through fieldStatusView.ts. (D) CATEGORY_NOT_LIVE 400 / 429 on text, link and camera (incl. the budget body) renders one coming-soon copy, never the Paywall and never seconds. The Paywall never fired at base either: only USAGE_LIMIT opens it. A non-OK SSE response carrying the code skips the REST fallback; the SSE error-event arm is already terminal at base and is pinned. The INSUFFICIENT_DATA `reason` gets per-reason copy. Base records: 232 client suites, rc=1 only from the 4 accepted nativeBundle.w37 drift nodes (2,400 passed / 4 failed / 13 pending); 23 backend SmartCompareApp-scanning pins pass, 1,846 tests ([pyt] OK); the 5 CLAUDE.md readers outside chunk 1 pass, 458 tests ([pyt] OK).

open_questions: Q-1 The events fence. A literal trackEvent('category_coming_soon_tap' in src turns tests/test_events_allowlist_superset.py RED, because the type is not allowlisted until SF1. The spec passes an exported constant, which the literal grep cannot see, and pins the absence of the literal (P11). That deliberately routes around the fence; the alternative is an additive VALID_EVENT_TYPES widening here (R-A1), which would put app/ in the footprint. Rule which one.
Q-2 home.hero 'Compare anything.' is not named in the brief but makes the same multi-category claim; the spec changes it to 'Compare two fragrances.'. Confirm or drop.

Q-3 Deleting CohortBadge costs E1 + 13 jest.mock line deletions (one inside the clientTruth/medicalNote.s74 fence) + the source-pin inversions; the alternative is keeping an unrendered file. The spec deletes it, per the brief.

Q-4 onboarding.s17.tag_echoes_body ('When 5+ peers your age just compared the same pair.') is rendered by Step17 and states a trigger threshold; it is kept as stated limit L7. Rule whether it falls in the cohort-number scope.
Q-5 ORPHAN-7 includes referrals.share.toast.confirm ('We'll add 5 more'), an unread key in the share namespace that CL4 owns. Confirm the deletion here.

Q-6 The Fragrances chip stays unselected by default. A pre-selected chip would send selected_category on every compare after the flip and move the resolver from the no-chip A2b arm to the chip arm (R-S10B-2). Confirm.
Q-7 The coming-soon chips are enabled but inert (tap = toast), per the brief; the App-Review lens may prefer accessibilityState disabled. Confirm.
Q-8 The deletion set is exactly 23 keys (the ORPHAN-7 set + the keys the removals orphan). The other 202 unreferenced keys carry no fabricated claim and stay (L1, follow-up). Confirm the scope.
Q-9 The exact row ids of E8 / E11 / E12 / E13 / E14 and the spec label keys for the C16 field lines are left to GREEN's measurement. Accept, or require them at RED.
